pathways.noneForStage: No programme matches this stage yet.

guide.title: For parents and counsellors
guide.hint: Written in Arabic first, then English.

ar.p1: البرامج المخصصة للمواطنين الإماراتيين مُعلَّمة بذلك على بطاقة البرنامج نفسها، قبل أي نموذج.
ar.p2: دبلوم التكنولوجيا النووية (24 شهراً) مخصص لخريجي الثانوية العامة من المواطنين، ويؤدي إلى وظيفة مشغّل محلي أو فني صيانة، مع مكافأة شهرية.
ar.p3: الطلب مبسّط: لا نطلب رقم الهوية الإماراتية أو تاريخ الميلاد إلا عندما تحتاجه مرحلة ما، وعندها عبر الهوية الرقمية (UAE Pass). وتتخذ الموارد البشرية في ENEC كل القرارات، ولا يرفض أي نظام آلي أي متقدم.
ar.p4: تُحذف بيانات الطلبات غير الناجحة وفق جدول منشور (بعد ستة أشهر من القرار في هذا العرض التجريبي).

en.p1: Programmes for UAE nationals only are marked on the programme card itself, before any form.
en.p2: The Diploma in Nuclear Technology (24 months) is for UAE high-school graduates and leads to Local Operator or Maintenance Technician, with a monthly stipend.
en.p3: Applications are light: no Emirates ID or date of birth until a stage needs it, and then through UAE Pass. ENEC HR makes every decision; no algorithm rejects an applicant.
en.p4: Data from unsuccessful applications is deleted on a published schedule (six months after the decision in this demo).

stories.title: Alumni stories
stories.hint: Published only with consent and after review, with first names only by default. The two below are illustrative placeholders written for this demo, not real people.

s1.name: Mariam
s1.quote: I joined straight after Grade 12. Learning on the simulator and on site made the control room feel real long before I qualified.

s2.name: Khalid
s2.quote: The programme was built around the position I was aiming for, so every rotation counted towards it.

programme.processHint: Stages are explained in plain language and mirrored from ENEC HR. You can follow them in My applications.
programme.rule1: No automated rejection: ENEC HR screens every application.
programme.rule2: We collect the minimum. No Emirates ID or date of birth until a stage needs it, and then through UAE Pass.
programme.rule3: If an application is not successful, its data is deleted on the published schedule.
programme.rolesHint: Open a role to see its responsibilities, qualifications and training path.

appExplain.interest: You registered your interest. We will tell you when applications open.
appExplain.submitted: Your application has been received. ENEC HR will check your eligibility next.
appExplain.screening: ENEC HR is checking your eligibility against the published criteria.
appExplain.assessment: A screening exam has been scheduled. ENEC HR will contact you with the details.
appExplain.interview: You are invited to the interview stage.

appExplain.accepted: You accepted the offer. Welcome to the talent pipeline.
appExplain.unsuccessful: Your application was not successful this time. This decision was made by ENEC HR, not by Kafa'a.

check.title: Check your eligibility
check.intro: Answer a few questions to see how the published criteria apply to you. Your answers stay in this browser tab.
check.noCriteria: This programme has no published criteria to check.

explain.nationality: This programme is published for the nationality shown. Other programmes on the Pathways page may fit you better.
explain.education: This programme expects the education shown. You can still look at programmes for your current stage.

check.resultYes: You appear to meet the published criteria.
check.resultUnsure: You may meet the criteria; ask the careers team about the points you are not sure of.
check.resultNo: You may not meet every published criterion.
check.notDecision: This is not a decision. Only ENEC HR decides on applications, and Dalil cannot judge an applicant.
check.nothingStored: Nothing you answer here is stored

apply.title: Apply: {name}
apply.intro: A light application or expression of interest. It takes about three minutes and asks only for what screening needs now.
apply.linkOutTitle: This programme takes applications on ENEC's official channel
apply.linkOutBody: Kafa'a explains the programme but does not collect applications for it.
apply.closedBody: The intake for this programme is closed. Register for an event or check back later.
apply.cannotBody: Applications are made from an applicant or employee account. Sign in with one of those role cards to apply.
apply.alreadyTitle: You already have an open application
apply.signInBody: You can read every programme without signing in. To submit, sign in with an applicant account so you can follow your application and withdraw it at any time.
apply.signIn: Sign in or create an applicant account
apply.doneBody: You will see each stage in My applications. ENEC HR will contact you about the next step.
apply.needAbout: Choose your stage and answer the nationality question (you may choose not to say).
apply.needConsent: Tick the consent box to submit.
apply.modeLabel: What would you like to do?
apply.eduHint: Optional. Certificates are checked later by HR, not uploaded here.
apply.minimumBody: No Emirates ID, passport number or date of birth is collected now. If a later stage needs them, ENEC HR asks for them through UAE Pass.
apply.consent: I agree that ENEC HR may process this application for this programme.
apply.consentHint: If the application is not successful or I withdraw it, its data is deleted six months later on the published schedule. I can withdraw at any time.
apply.confirmBody: Your answers are sent to ENEC HR for screening. You can follow the stages and withdraw at any time from My applications.

my.intro: Each stage is explained in plain language. Stages and decisions are mirrored from ENEC HR; Kafa'a never decides.
my.noneBody: Start with the Pathways page to find a programme for your stage.
my.right1: We hold only what screening needs now. Identity documents are requested later through UAE Pass, if at all.
my.right2: Data from unsuccessful or withdrawn applications is deleted six months after the decision.
my.right3: ENEC HR makes every decision. Ask the careers team if you want a decision explained.
my.withdrawBody: The application closes and cannot be reopened. Its data is deleted six months from today. You can apply again later.

hr.intro: Counts by programme and stage. Any cell under the minimum group size is suppressed. The HR authority (CHCO office) also screens applications and records ENEC HR decisions.
hr.noAutoBody: Kafa'a mirrors ENEC HR decisions. Nothing here scores, ranks or rejects an applicant automatically, and the funnel never shows names.
hr.visibleTotalSub: Suppressed cells are not added in
hr.funnelNote: Counts of applications currently at each stage. Cells under {n} show "<10" and conversion is not computed across them.
hr.matrixNote: Export includes counts only, with suppressed cells marked, a watermark, your role and the date.
hr.minimumNote: Applicants are identified by reference only. Identity documents are requested through UAE Pass at the stage that needs them.
hr.noteHint: Shown to the applicant in plain language. At least 5 characters.
hr.readOnly: Read-only view: only the HR authority records decisions.
hr.confirmBody: Application {id} moves to "{stage}". The applicant sees the new stage and your note.
hr.retentionBody: Unsuccessful and withdrawn applications are deleted six months after the decision. The table shows how many records are scheduled each month.
hr.noneScheduled: No records are scheduled for deletion.

talent.intro: Keep vacancies, outreach events, internship placements and programme intake up to date. Public pages read from here.
talent.rulesBody: Vacancies always link to ENEC's official careers channel, where applications are made. Mark anything not yet confirmed by ENEC as sample. Roles reserved for UAE nationals are flagged only where ENEC publicly reserves them.
talent.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
talent.uaeOnly: Reserved for UAE nationals (only where ENEC publicly reserves the role)
talent.title: Title
talent.closeBody: It disappears from the public pages. The official careers channel is not changed.
talent.programmesHint: Open or close the intake for a programme, or send applicants to ENEC's official channel. Programme facts and sources are edited in the content console.
talent.intakeBody: {name} will show "{mode}" on every public page.

journey.intro: Follow one continuous path: discover your interests, try a STEM experience, choose a route (DNT, Energy Pioneers, GDP or GPO) and see the first roles it leads to. Every fact shows its source and date.

here.school: You are at the start: explore your interests and look out for Mustaqbali.
here.finishing_school: You are at the route step: the Diploma in Nuclear Technology or an Energy Pioneers scholarship come next.
here.university: You are at the route step: Energy Pioneers and university internships fit you now.
here.graduate: You are at the route step: the Graduate Development Program or Graduate Plant Operator fit you now.

journey.pickStage: Pick where you are to see "You are here" on the board.
journey.storeSignedIn: Signed in: press Save to keep your journey. Only you can see it.
journey.storeNothing: Nothing on this page is stored or sent while you are not signed in.
journey.boardHint: Four stations from school to your first role. Every programme fact links its public source and the date it refers to.
journey.noFacts: Journey facts are not available right now.
journey.exploreBody: Find out which kinds of nuclear work fit you, try the free practice quizzes and go to events.
journey.firstRoleNote: Roles open on the career map. Licensed roles follow later, after training and FANR certification.

journey.noQuestions: The explorer is not available right now.

journey.noScore: The explorer only shows which of your answers point where. It does not grade you or compare you with anyone, and every route stays open to you.
journey.readyHint: Check the published eligibility for your route and tick off the steps to get ready. Nothing here is a decision.

elig.unsure: Some answers are unsure: check them at an information session

journey.readyNote: The checklist is for you. It never decides anything, and ENEC HR makes every decision through its official process.

journey.rulesBody: Kafa'a never compares students with each other and never turns anyone down automatically. It mirrors ENEC's official programmes; every decision is made by ENEC HR through its official process.

jinsights.intro: How students use the journey: counts only, from saved journeys. Every cell with fewer than 10 people is suppressed. No student is listed, compared or turned down here.
jinsights.refused: Journey insights are not available to you

tileSub.applied: Have an application to the route they saved

jinsights.byFamilyHint: People whose saved answers point to each job family (up to three families each).
jinsights.allSuppressed: Every family is under the minimum group size.
jinsights.credBody: Accepted Mustaqbali participants receive a synthetic starter credential in their portfolio. It is a portfolio record, not a FANR certification or an ENEC qualification.
jinsights.issueConsequence: {n} accepted participants receive the starter credential in their portfolio and a notice. This is recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.

starter.intro: Two short starters before you join ENEC: AI literacy and next-generation reactors. Read, check yourself and follow the sources. Self-checks are for you only.
starter.storeNothing: Nothing on this page is stored or sent
starter.storeSigned: Signed in: you can keep your progress in your saved journey

trackHint.ai: Five short lessons: what AI is, checking outputs, fairness and privacy, AI learning in the UAE, and AI at a nuclear plant.
trackHint.smr: Three short lessons on small modular reactors, what changes for Barakah roles, and nuclear careers.

starter.noLessons: No starter lessons are published yet
starter.noDeploy: No deployment decision is implied. These lessons help you learn about newer reactor designs; nothing here is a site, a headcount or a schedule.
starter.noDeployShort: Planning view: no deployment decision implied.
starter.secondaryHint: Reported by a secondary source or a news report; confirm against the original.
starter.saved: Starter progress saved in your journey
starter.saveHint: Save which lessons you checked to your journey. Only you can see it.
starter.saveNotForRole: Progress is kept for students and applicants with a Kafa'a account; you can still use every lesson.
starter.saveAnon: Nothing is saved while you are not signed in. Sign in as a student to keep your progress.
starter.signIn: Sign in to keep your progress
starter.baselinesHint: HR publishes a baseline for each intake year: modules the intake already holds are skipped, partly held ones become a short refresher. Mandatory nuclear modules are always taught.
starter.noModules: The induction catalogue is not published yet
starter.noBaselines: No intake baseline is published yet
starter.previewFrom: From the baseline for {scope}, version {version}, published {date}.
starter.previewNone: No published baseline for this intake yet: the full induction applies.
starter.catalogueHint: Every module new joiners can take, with its hours. Modules marked always taught are never skipped.
starter.rulesBody: The starter is static content: answering a self-check sends nothing and keeps no result. Baselines describe a whole intake year, never one person, and only shorten induction; they never compare or select anyone.
starter.teaserHint: Get ready for the skills new joiners need: AI literacy and next-generation reactors. Try one self-check here.

myind.intro: Your induction plan, built by HR from the baseline for your intake year. Modules your intake already holds are skipped; mandatory nuclear modules are always taught.
myind.emptyBody: HR builds an induction plan when you join one of ENEC's entry programmes. Meanwhile you can try the future-skills starter.
myind.noBaseline: No baseline was published for your intake when the plan was built, so it is the full induction.
myind.stale: HR has published a different baseline for your intake since this plan was built. HR will rebuild your plan.
myind.planHint: Each module shows whether you do it in full, as a short refresher or skip it, and why.
myind.notAuthority: This plan only shortens induction. It is not a qualification, licence or authorisation record; those stay with the licensee's systems.

ibw.intro: Set what each intake year already holds so induction stops re-teaching it, and keep every joiner's induction plan on the current baseline. Mandatory nuclear modules are locked.
ibw.readOnly: Read only: baselines and plans are edited by HR (workforce strategy W).
ibw.locked: Always taught: mandatory modules cannot be skipped or shortened by a baseline.

problem.year: Give an intake year between 2020 and 2035.
problem.programme: Choose all programmes or one entry programme.
problem.entries: Mark at least one module as held, partly held or not held.
problem.module: Every entry names a listed induction module.
problem.status: Each entry is held, partly held or not held.
problem.basis: A held or partly held module needs its basis.
problem.mandatory: Mandatory nuclear modules are never skipped or shortened.
problem.source: A national-curriculum basis cites an https source; sources start with https://.
problem.note: Notes are at most 300 characters per module and 600 for the baseline.

ibw.confirmDraft: The draft is visible to HR, training staff and auditors only. Induction plans keep reading the published baseline.
ibw.confirmPublish: It becomes the public baseline for the {year} intake and replaces the previous version. {n} induction plans of that intake will read it once rebuilt.
ibw.staleBody: A newer baseline is published for their intake. Rebuild them so induction stops re-teaching what they hold.
ibw.confirmRebuild: {n} plans will be rebuilt from the published baseline for each joiner's intake year. Each joiner is notified.
ibw.joinersHint: Joiners with a plan, offered or accepted applicants of the entry programmes (intake the year after the decision) and entry-level staff hired in the last year.
ibw.confirmBuild: The plan reads the published baseline for this programme and intake year (all programmes if there is no programme baseline). The joiner is notified.
